references.text: Timnah is mentioned as the place where Samson met his Philistine wife, the same Timnah that is noted in Joshua's territorial description for Dan.
Ekron is mentioned here as one of the Philistine cities, which was originally assigned to the tribe of Dan.
Ekron is mentioned as one of the five main Philistine cities where the Lord's ark was sent.
Ekron is one of the five Philistine cities that had to send a guilt offering to the God of Israel.
Ekron is mentioned in connection with the god Baal-Zebub, whom King Ahaziah sent messengers to consult.
Ekron and Timnah are mentioned in the boundary description of Judah's territory, showing the geographical overlap between the tribes.
Ekron is listed among the cities that Judah captured, even though it had been assigned to Dan.
